title: Sheba Mental Care App
summary: A student app built with Sheba Medical Center that helps patients express their feelings before psychiatric treatment.
description:
In collaboration with **Sheba Medical Center**, students developed an app that helps patients convey their feelings and emotions before psychiatric treatment.

The app includes:

- **A body character** that patients use to show where they feel pain or discomfort.
- **Graphical questionnaires** with matching images, so patients can rate feelings visually.
- **Upcoming meetings** with their care team.

The answers are shown to the doctor **before the meeting**, so the doctor has a better picture of how the patient is doing.
